CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress CIFS ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to CIFS ports (TCP: 139, 445).
Risk: These ports handle SMB file sharing and Windows file/printer sharing. Attackers can exploit vulnerable SMB implementations (like EternalBlue) to deploy ransomware, laterally move through networks, or directly access sensitive files without authentication.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
